doc_title: APPLICATION BY AN INTERESTED PERSON TO ASCERTAIN AND FIX THE BOUNDARIES OF LAND
doc_title_official: APPLICATION BY AN INTERESTED PERSON TO ASCERTAIN AND FIX THE BOUNDARIES OF LAND
when_used: The registered proprietor or an interested person asks the Land Registrar to ascertain and fix the boundaries of a parcel of land.

detail_rows.label: Name of Applicant / Interested Party: Give full name(s)
Registered Proprietors of land adjoining Give full name(s)
Address (within Kenya for service of notice)

body_text.text: The registered Proprietor/Interested Party HEREBY APPLIES to the Land Registrar to ascertain and fix the boundaries of the above land.

custom_fields.name: adjoining_proprietors
custom_fields.label: Registered proprietors of the adjoining land
custom_fields.prompt: Full name of the registered proprietor of every parcel adjoining the land, numbered 1, 2 and 3 as the form prints them

custom_fields.name: applicant_address
custom_fields.label: Address of the Applicant
custom_fields.prompt: Address within Kenya at which notice of the boundary hearing may be served on the applicant
